title: DCPSC Order No. 22898 (2026-07-07) — The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in Formal Case No. EA2026-06, by Order No. 22898, dated July 7, 2026, granted a license to EIQdigital
description: The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in Formal Case No. EA2026-06, by Order No. 22898, dated July 7, 2026, granted a license to EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy to function as an electricity supplier in the District of Columbia.
text:
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA 
1325 G STREET N.W., SUITE 800 
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20005 

ORDER UNDER DELEGATED AUTHORITY 

July 7, 2026 
FORMAL CASE NO. EA2026-06, IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF 
EIQDIGITAL, INC. D/B/A PERSONALIZED.ENERGY FOR AN ELECTRICITY 
SUPPLIER LICENSE, Order No. 22898 

I. 
INTRODUCTION 

1. 
By this Order,1 the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia 
(“Commission”) grants a license to EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy (“EIQdigital” or 
“Applicant”) to function as an electricity supplier in the District of Columbia.2 The license for 
EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy is effective upon issuance of this Order. 
II. 
BACKGROUND 

2. 
On May 6, 2026, EIQdigital filed its license application.3 Specifically, EIQdigital 
intends to operate as a broker of electricity pursuant to § 4601 in Chapter 46 (Electricity 
Suppliers) of Title 15 of the District of Columbia Municipal Regulations.4 The Applicant 
represents that it intends to serve residential customers in the District of Columbia. EIQdigital 
filed supplemental information on June 12, 2026.5 

III. 
DISCUSSION & DECISION 

3. 
Our review of the information contained in EIQdigital’s application and 
supplemental filing demonstrates that it has met all the prescribed licensing requirements and 

1 
This Order is issued under delegated authority pursuant to Order No. 22731. See Formal Case No. 712, In 
the Matter of the Investigation into the Public Service Commission’s Rules of Practice and Procedure, Order 
No. 22731, ¶ 2(a), issued October 30, 2025 (“The Commission’s General Counsel, or his or her designee, is 
delegated authority to act and issue orders on the following matters: . . . (a) Electric Applications”). Any party may 
file a petition for reconsideration of the General Counsel’s decision with the Commission. 

2 
D.C. Official Code § 34-1501(17) (2001) defines, in part, an electricity supplier as “a person, including an 
aggregator, broker, or marketer, who generates electricity; sells electricity; or purchases, brokers, arranges or 
markets electricity for sale to customers.” 

3 
Formal Case No. EA2026-06, In the Matter of the Application of EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a 
Personalized.energy for an Electricity Supplier License (“Formal Case No. EA2026-06”), Application of 
EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy filed May 6, 2026. 

4 
See 71 DCR 007434 (June 28, 2024). 

5 
Formal Case No. EA2026-06, Response to Deficiency Notification, filed June 12, 2026.

that the Applicant has the ability and financial integrity to serve electricity customers in the 
District of Columbia. The Commission also finds that granting EIQdigital’s application will 
serve the public interest by fostering competition in the District’s energy market. Accordingly, 
EIQdigital’s application is approved. 
THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED THAT: 
4. 
The application of EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy for a license to 
conduct business in the District of Columbia as an electricity supplier is hereby GRANTED. 
The license for EIQdigital, Inc. d/b/a Personalized.energy is effective upon issuance of this 
Order.

BY DIRECTION OF THE COMMISSION:

BRINDA WESTBROOK-SEDGWICK
